objective: Differentiate a mass tea brand through a recurring platform about civic awareness.
businessContext: Tea advertising had an opportunity to connect the morning ritual of waking up with social and civic alertness.
strategy: Turn the product ritual into a durable brand idea that can address changing national issues.
execution: campaign chapters on voting, corruption, gender and community welfare
outcomes: Tata Consumer documents Jaago Re as a landmark platform used across multiple issues since 2007.
whatWorked: The brand mnemonic and social message share the same wake-up metaphor.
The platform could renew around current issues.
whatFailed: The cited sources do not provide an incremental business-effect estimate.
transferConditions: A stable brand idea can accommodate multiple relevant cultural issues.
nonTransferConditions: Do not treat campaign longevity alone as proof of sales lift.
